name: commander
description: Guided AI PM for Claude Code, running on the Commander Method: 12 enforceable gates (plan before build, verifier separate from worker, prove before alarm). 93 plugin skills (click-first /ccc-* workflows, incl. /ccc-codex for the Codex CLI; 29 model-visible, the rest load on demand), 23 specialist sub-agents (architect, reviewer, debugger, designer, security-auditor…), 28 lifecycle hooks × 47 handlers, a Commander HUD mod, 6 distributable workflows, 13 plugin evals, 2 bundled MCP servers + 16 opt-in. Telemetry is off unless you opt in. Built for Claude Opus 5.5 / Fable 5.2 and Codex GPT-6. Works in Claude Code Desktop, CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Codex. MIT-licensed.

telemetry.title: Anonymous usage telemetry
telemetry.description: Send anonymous usage events (hook and skill names, timings). Off unless you turn it on. CCC_TELEMETRY still works, and an explicit off from either wins.

offline.title: Offline mode
offline.description: Block every network call Commander makes itself (telemetry, update check, CI ticker). Same as CCC_OFFLINE=1.

cost_ceiling.title: Tool-call budget ceiling
cost_ceiling.description: Optional session budget in units (5 = 500 tool calls): warns once, then denies further tool calls. Leave empty for no ceiling. CCC_COST_CEILING wins when set.

mcp_url.title: Commander MCP endpoint
mcp_url.description: Optional URL of a Commander MCP server for passthrough calls. Leave empty for the hosted default. CCC_MCP_URL wins when set.

mcp_token.title: Commander MCP access token
mcp_token.description: Optional bearer token for the hosted Commander MCP server, kept in your credential store, not settings.json. CCC_MCP_TOKEN or COMMANDER_TOKEN win when set.
